messages:
amy: Heads-up — postmortem follow-up for last night's KV OOM. I'm collating action items + owners so we can close the loop. Short thread to confirm assignments and timelines.

tariq: I can own the profiling run and flamegraphs. ETA EOD Thursday. Plan is: run full-heap sampling across two healthy replicas + one canary, diff against the last baseline. Will post artifacts.

lin: I'll pick up GC tuning and slab/bucket changes. Initial proposal: enable more aggressive compaction on shard-evictor and reduce the largest slab bucket from 64MB -> 32MB to avoid long-lived fragmentation. Want to run a 5% canary first.

amy: Added a tracker ticket (RINF-1234) — please append PRs and links there. Success criteria we can agree on: fewer than 1 OOM incident/week for 30d rolling, and 50% reduction in median RSS during heavy rerank windows. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline kicked off: canary job kv-evict-tweak-v2 -> staging (build 5821). Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/5821

tariq: Profiling notes (quick): saw a sustained KV residency bump correlated with heavy rerank bursts. Sample snippet: `alloc_table::insert` hot path — appears to be repeated partial inserts from the rerank pipeline. Will upload flamegraphs to the ticket.

maya: I'll own metrics/dashboard + alert changes. Plan: add a histogram for `kv.residency_ms`, `kv.rss_bytes` per shard, and a new anomaly alert when 95p residency > 30s. Timeline: deliver monitoring PR by tomorrow noon.

lin: For the canary: 5% traffic, monitor for 48h. Rollback triggers: GC CPU increase > +20% or steady RSS drift for 6 hours. Also enabling per-tenant soft limits (ephemeral) to prevent one noisy tenant causing cluster-wide OOM.

amy: Action summary for thread — Tariq: profiling + artifacts (EOD Thu). Lin: GC + slab canary (deploy next Tue, 5% traffic). Maya: metrics/alerts (tomorrow). Amy: customer comms + track remediation progress. We'll do a sync Fri 11am to review results and decide rollout. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: Noted, I will keep the incident channel open and add an oncall-runbook snippet to the ticket for immediate steps. Quick snippet: \n```\nif memory trend > 2x baseline -> scale read-only replicas\nif OOM observed -> send sigterm to writers to shed load, switch to fallback model\ncapture pprof and last 10s of alloc traces\n```\n
amy: Thanks all — please update RINF-1234 as you complete tasks. If anyone needs more time call it out here.
